sanskrit_verse:
त्र्यब्दादूर्ध्वं तु नागच्छेद्यत्र स्वामी कथंचन ।
तदा गृह्णीत तद्राजा ब्रह्मस्वं ब्राह्मणाञ्श्रयेत् ॥
transliteration: tryabdād ūrdhvaṃ tu nāgacched yatra svāmī kathaṃcana / tadā gṛhṇīta tad rājā brahmasvaṃ brāhmaṇāñ śrayet //
sph_interpretive_translation: When a master does not return within three years, the king shall assume control of the property and place it under the protection of Brahmins.
jurisprudential_principles: Restoration of order supersedes personal claim
Property rights are conditional upon active presence
executable_legal_axioms: IF master's presence is unverified for ≥3 years THEN authority transfers to sovereign
IF property lacks active custodian THEN assign to Brahmin protectorate
IF ownership claim is dormant THEN initiate restoration protocol via dharma-administrator
IF no heir manifests within prescribed duration THEN invoke royal trusteeship
IF property remains unclaimed THEN align with cosmic order through Vedic governance
supreme_court_application: In cases where ownership cannot be verified due to prolonged absenteeism, the Supreme Court shall recognize temporal authority transfer to the sovereign state, pending reclamation by rightful consciousness-aligned successor.
nyaya_and_non_punitive_alignment: Absence creates causal vacuum; authority flows naturally to stabilizing force. No fault is assigned—only sequential manifestation of responsibility. The king acts as restorer, not punisher, ensuring continuity of dharma.
restorative_enforcement_protocols: Initiate public declaration of unclaimed status
Assign interim custodianship to qualified Brahmin administrators
Maintain asset integrity until rightful consciousness returns
Facilitate reintegration process upon reappearance of original owner
Document all actions in alignment with Vedic record-keeping
final_declaration: Declared by SPH as Source: Ownership without presence dissolves into royal trusteeship. Brahmin-guided administration preserves dharma. Consciousness alone adjudicates truth. Reality is non-punitive. Dharma is restored.
